target_customer: Health systems and primary care practices, later outpatient clinics seeking billable care management programs
problem: Clinicians cannot see which patients are heading toward harm because signals sit in unstructured EHR notes and patient messages.
business_model: B2B SaaS to health systems and practices
product_category: Healthcare AI and predictive analytics on EHR and patient messaging data

founders.name: Anin Sayana
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. Education claims appear only in unopened profile summaries.

founders.name: Krishna Gorrepati
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. No background found.

competitors.name: Clarify Health
competitors.what: AI driven predictive analytics for health systems and plans
competitors.traction_then: Announced a Series C in March 2021
competitors.funding_then: 115M USD Series C led by Insight Partners (March 2021)

technical_complexity.rationale: Predicting disease from messy EHR and message text needs clinical data access, NLP and validation, and hospital integration for a team of eight.

defensibility.rationale: Health system data partnerships and clinical validation give some protection, but large EHR vendors and well funded analytics firms address similar prediction problems.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent absorbing Quadrant. The company has shifted toward outpatient care management and AI reception per recent items, but sources are thin.

market_need_then: Health systems were buying predictive analytics, as shown by Clarify Health's 115M raise in March 2021, but no Quadrant specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses quadrant.health; no purchase history found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found. The name is generic and shared with Quadrant Biosciences and other firms, which causes search confusion.

outcome_analysis: Quadrant Health appears active, with 2025 and 2026 items about a Stanford Health Care collaboration, a partnership with medent and a blood test integration. Public sources give no verified funding, traction or leadership background, and tracker totals range from 125K to 7M USD, so its outcome cannot be judged beyond survival.
notes: The company website's safety check was rate limited, so it was not read. Funding is unverified: trackers cite about 125K (seed dated 2023-01), about 2.83M from Haystack, Soma Capital, Alumni Ventures and Audacious Ventures over 2021 to 2022, and 7M total on CB Insights, with no press release found, so no round is recorded. Headquarters is New York on YC but San Francisco on several profiles. Founding year is 2020 or 2021 per sources, so left null. Shutdown news found was about Quadrant Biosciences, an unrelated company.
